name: savee
title: Savee
description: Browse your Savee saves, feed and boards, search Savee's library, and copy or download images, with AI tools.
author: peduarte

commands.name: search-saves
commands.title: Search Saves
commands.subtitle: Savee
commands.description: Browse and filter your saves and home feed

commands.name: search-boards
commands.title: Search Boards
commands.subtitle: Savee
commands.description: Browse your boards and the saves on them

commands.name: search-library
commands.title: Search Library
commands.subtitle: Savee
commands.description: Search Savee's public library for references

tools.name: search-saves
tools.title: Search Saves
tools.description: Find the user's own Savee saves or home feed items by title, source, colour or visual description

tools.name: get-save
tools.title: Get Save
tools.description: Fetch one Savee save by its savee.com link, short id or id

tools.name: list-boards
tools.title: List Boards
tools.description: List the user's Savee boards and sub boards with their ids and save counts

tools.name: list-board-saves
tools.title: List Board Saves
tools.description: List the saves on one Savee board

tools.name: search-library
tools.title: Search Library
tools.description: Search Savee's public library for references the user hasn't saved yet. Limited to 200 searches a week

ai.instructions: Savee is a visual inspiration library. Use search-saves for the user's own saves or feed, and search-library only when they want references they haven't saved, because library searches are limited to 200 a week. When citing a save, include its source URL so the user can find the original work. The Savee API is read-only: you can't save, edit or delete anything.

preferences.name: personalAccessToken
preferences.title: Personal Access Token
preferences.description: Your Savee personal access token (sv_live_…). Generate one in Savee → Settings → Developers. Needs an active Savee subscription.
